name: Pm Claude Skills
description: 90 Claude Skills across 14 professions — the largest open-source professional skills library for Claude Code. Covers product management, marketing, engineering, data, design, Figma, legal, finance, HR, sales, operations, research, and more. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that teaches Claude how to produce professional-grade outputs for recurring workflows. Install the full library in one command or pick individual profession bundles. 210+ GitHub stars, MIT licence, open for community contributions.
longDescription:
Ships **98 skills**.

- **Skills** (98): `ab-test-planner` (Designs statistically rigorous A/B tests for product features, UI changes, onboarding flows, and pricing experiments), `accessibility-audit` (Generate a WCAG 2.2 accessibility audit checklist and remediation suggestions for any UI or design), `account-plan` (Build a structured account plan for any key customer or target account), `ai-product-canvas` (Structures AI and ML product decisions including model selection, data requirements, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI considerations), `ambiguity-resolver` (Structures vague opportunities and unclear briefs into actionable), `api-docs-writer` (Write clear, developer-facing API documentation), `architecture-decision-record` (Create an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) for any technical decision), `assumption-mapper` (Extract and risk-rate all hidden assumptions in a product brief or PRD), and 90 more

Installs with `claude plugin install pm-claude-skills@claude-community` from `mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills`.
